svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 MQTT Gateway: auth, virtual sessions, uplink, downlink and reconnect

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 MQTT Gateway: auth, virtual sessions, uplink, downlink and reconnect
MQTT endpoint and physical Gateway authentication
A v1/gateway/** topic does not grant Gateway capability.
gatewaySessionHandler remains null for an ordinary device.
CONNACK follows the Core producer callback.
It does not wait for Device Actor OPEN handling or state persistence.
MQTT subscriptions and virtual-device session creation
MQTT SUBSCRIBE does not create virtual Actor subscriptions.
Each virtual OPEN already carries attributes and RPC subscriptions.
[first telemetry, attributes, request or RPC response for a missing name]
Device and credentials share DeviceService.saveDevice transaction.
The connect PUBACK does not wait for Core production or Actor handling.
Gateway telemetry and client attributes uplink
Every outer entry reuses the physical MQTT packetId in its callback.
There is no cross-device ACK barrier, rollback, or deduplication table.
PUBACK confirms Queue production, not Rule Chain or database commit.
Attributes request and Shared Attributes downlink
Live downlink uses subscription nodeId + virtual sessionId.
additionalInfo.lastConnectedGateway is not a channel-routing lookup.
Server-side RPC downlink and Gateway response
Gateway virtual sessions have no MID-to-RPC awaiting-ACK map.
Physical PUBACK is not correlated back to virtual DELIVERED.
Gateway client-side RPC request is not implemented.
The business response, not MQTT PUBACK, completes a two-way RPC.
Virtual disconnect, physical close and reconnect
cleanSession=false does not restore Gateway maps, subscriptions,
inflight packets, listeners, or the Netty channel.
Redis may restore Actor metadata only; default cache is caffeine.
